text:
</sub>  Pin an immutable model for retrospective controls

In AC15's retrospective matched-control path, “same model” can currently mean the same configured alias: `src/config/load-config.ts:89-90` supplies `modelName`, while the new AC8 text explicitly acknowledges that the recorded `qwen-plus` alias is mutable. If the provider updates that alias between the published sweep-on review and a later sweep-off control, the evidence can satisfy this condition while attributing model drift to the sweep. Require an immutable model version for both arms, or require controls to be collected in a precommitted window where that identity is guaranteed stable.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/90a694eabddd7a1d3a45d741c85e45d0c19df7b6/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
